title: Srce kuca
subtitle: 16 cinematic shots · A heartbeat · Two people, one table · Analog noir
concept: The song is about two people at a table who keep almost-touching and never do. 'Ne diraj tišinu' — do not disturb the silence. The shots are a slow, close, uneventful evening: a glass of wine, a chair, a lamp, a hand that stops a centimetre short. Nothing dramatic happens. The tension is in the distance the camera never closes.
visualDna: 1970s European arthouse cinema, faded Kodak 500T, tobacco browns, dirty teal, nicotine yellow, winter gray, soft halation, analog grain, practical light, natural imperfections, unposed documentary realism, 35mm anamorphic
_note_visualDna: The same house DNA as the NEMA ME U MENI template — one film language across the artist's work. The DNA is PALETTE and TEXTURE and it goes in the prose, not a --profile, because the artist dictated the profile codes separately.

frames.title: OPET SI TU
frames.lyric: Opet si tu / Kao da nisi / Gledaš kroz mene
frames.prose: Wide static shot of a small kitchen table at night in a Belgrade flat, a woman seated on one side and a man on the other, a single low lamp between them, both turned slightly away, the room dark past the lamp's reach, quiet repetition, faded 35mm film, imperfect natural exposure, observational European cinema.
frames.camera: both figures small in the frame with the lamp between them, the camera square on at the height of the table

frames.title: KO ZNA ŠTA MISLIŠ
frames.lyric: Ko zna šta misliš / Pomeriš kosu / Nešto bi rekla / Pa samo ćutiš / Kao da čeKAŠ
frames.prose: A woman at a kitchen table lifting her hand to push her hair back from her face, her mouth just open as if about to say something and not saying it, one lamp low beside her, the wall behind her bare, her eyes on someone just out of the picture
frames.camera: her hand and the side of her face in the near half of the picture, seen from just below and to one side, the lamp catching the edge of her hair

frames.title: NA STOLU ČAŠA
frames.lyric: Na stolu čaša / Još malo vina / Među nama / Ta stara tišina
frames.prose: Close on a half-full wine glass standing on a worn kitchen table, the wine catching the one lamp's light, the table scarred and marked with old rings, a second glass out of focus beyond it, nothing else moving, grainy imperfect 35mm frame.
frames.camera: the glass filling the lower half of the picture, the camera down at the level of the tabletop

frames.title: NE DIRAJ TIŠINU
frames.lyric: Ne diraj tišinu, / ne diraj, ne diraj
frames.prose: Two hands resting on a table, one hand just reaching towards the other and stopping a centimetre short, the fingers loose and unmoving, weak lamp light across the knuckles, the rest of the room black, the near hand sharp and the far hand soft, intimate domestic stillness, unpolished analog film.
frames.camera: the two hands filling the frame, the camera low and square to the edge of the table

frames.title: NEKA NOĆ NE PROLAZI
frames.lyric: Neka sve ostane tu, / neka noć ne prolazi
frames.prose: A window in a dark flat at night, the glass showing the same dark street outside, a thin curtain hanging still against the frame, the windows of the building opposite lit and unchanged, no movement in the room behind the camera
frames.camera: the window filling the frame, seen square on to the glass, the lit windows opposite small and far away

frames.title: TAKO BLIZU, TAKO DALEKO
frames.lyric: Tako blizu, tako daleko, / ali opet tu si sa mnom
frames.prose: A man and a woman seated opposite each other at a kitchen table, a small lamp standing between them, her face turned towards him and his turned away, a wine glass in front of each, the bare wall behind them, both sitting perfectly still, neither speaking, the lamp the only light in the room
frames.camera: her shoulder and the side of her face in the near half of the picture, him beyond her at the far side of the table, seen from just behind and above her shoulder

frames.title: JA VEĆ NISAM TU
frames.lyric: Ne diraj tišinu / Kad mi to treba / Ja već nisam tu
frames.prose: An empty chair pushed back from a kitchen table, a man's coat gone from the back of it, a set of keys left on the table beside a wine glass, one lamp still burning on the table over nothing, the room around the chair bare
frames.camera: the empty chair in the near half of the picture with the keys on the table beyond it, seen from just above the table edge

frames.title: KUĆA SVJETLO
frames.lyric: Kažeš da sam čudo / Da me nema često
frames.prose: A hallway in an old flat, one bare bulb burning above a doorway at the far end, the door frame standing open, the wall beside it carrying the shadow of two people standing close together, the ceiling low, the floor bare boards, one warm pool of light and everything else unlit
frames.camera: the open doorway at the far end of the hallway, the door frame crossing the edges of the picture, the hallway tilted so the floor runs diagonally

frames.title: SAMO MENJAM MESTO
frames.lyric: Samo menjam mesto / Neke stvari traju
frames.prose: Seen straight down from above onto a kitchen table, a man seated alone on one side of it, his coat still on, one hand holding a set of keys he has not put down, the empty chair opposite him, a wine glass and a plate untouched, a small lamp burning at the edge of the table
frames.camera: the table filling the whole picture from directly overhead, the man small beneath it, the tabletop seen flat

frames.title: TI ME PITAŠ NEŠTO
frames.lyric: Ti me pitaš nešto / I ja se samo smejem
frames.prose: A woman leaning across a kitchen table with her mouth open in the middle of a question, a man opposite her with his head down and his shoulders moving as he laughs, one lamp between them, a wine glass untouched in front of him
frames.camera: the two of them across the table, her near and him beyond, seen from the side of the table at the height of her shoulder

frames.title: SVE ŠTO IMAM
frames.lyric: Sve što imam / S tobom bih držao u ruci / A opet te tražim / U svakom tom zvuku
frames.prose: Close on a man's hands cupped around a wine glass, the glass barely held and the wine still, his thumb moving once along the rim, a woman's hand entering the edge of the frame and stopping, weak tungsten light catching the glass and the wet ring it leaves, tactile film grain, no glamour.
frames.camera: the hands and the glass filling the picture, the camera down at the level of the table and slightly to the side

frames.title: TAKO BLIZU, TAKO DALEKO
frames.lyric: Tako blizu, tako daleko, / ali opet tu si sa mnom
frames.prose: Seen from a doorway into an almost bare room at night, a man and a woman seated at a table at the far end with a single lamp burning between them, the walls bare and the floor bare, nothing else in the room, the darkness reaching the edges of the picture, the pair small and far off
frames.camera: the pair small at the far end of the room seen from the doorway, the bare room between them and the camera

frames.title: U OVOM NAŠEM VREMENU
frames.lyric: U ovom našem vremenu / U ovom našem prostoru / Nema drugih stvari / Samo ti i ja
frames.prose: A kitchen at night, a table at the far end of it with two people seated there, one lamp on the table between them, the room almost empty, the floor bare, the darkness reaching the far corners
frames.camera: the two people small at the far end of the room, the length of the kitchen between them and the camera, the lamp the only light

frames.title: TAČNO TI I JA
frames.lyric: Nema drugih stvari / Samo ti i ja
frames.prose: A man and a woman standing close together, a small lamp on a table behind them throwing their two shadows onto the wall, the lamp flaring between their faces, their hands almost meeting, the rest of the room unlit, the wall behind them the only thing lit
frames.camera: the two shadows thrown onto the wall filling the picture, the pair seen from behind and slightly to one side

frames.title: SADA JE VRIJEME
frames.lyric: Sada je vreme, sada je kasno / Dođi, da bude jasnije
frames.prose: A woman in the near foreground with her back to us, her shoulder and the back of her head filling one edge of the picture, a man across the table lifting his wine glass a few centimetres and then holding it there, a lamp between them, the bare wall behind him, the space between them empty
frames.camera: her shoulder along the near edge of the picture and him beyond her across the table, seen from just behind her

frames.title: NE DIRAJ TIŠINU
frames.lyric: Ne diraj tišinu, / ne diraj, ne diraj / Neka sve ostane tu, / neka noć ne prolazi
frames.prose: Extreme close-up of two wine glasses standing almost touching on the worn kitchen table, one of them still half full, weak lamp light on the rim of the nearer glass, the room behind them dissolved into shadow, the surface of the table holding the reflection of both, a last look, intimate domestic stillness, unpolished analog film, faded 35mm film, imperfect natural exposure.
frames.camera: the two glasses filling the frame and the room gone behind them, the camera down at the level of the tabletop

_note_order: THE ORDER IS THE LYRIC'S. Sixteen frames is not twelve plus four appended — the set is re-sequenced to the song's sections (verse 1 · chorus 1 · verse 2 · chorus 2 · bridge · final chorus) and the four new beats are placed where the song puts them.
_note_cells: THE PICKED CELL per shot — the 4-up grid is four different takes, and measurement SCREENS (median luma, nothing blown) while the eye DECIDES on content.
